meta.name: Rugrats Crecidos
meta.description: Serie basada en la vida de los Rugrats "Aventuras en pañales" pero algo más creciditos, en la que destacó la presencia de todos los personajes de la serie original. La serie se inició debido a un episodio especial celebrando el décimo aniversario de los Rugrats.

videos.title: Guerra civil
videos.overview: Lil es invitada a una fiesta con todos los chicos populares de la escuela, con la condición de que su hermano no vaya con ella, ya que los chicos creen que es "socialmente inepto" y "falto de higiene". Lil comienza a alejarse de Phil, aunque él quiera mantenerse cerca de ella.

videos.title: Susie busca la fama
videos.overview: Luego de conocer a una mujer de una agencia de talentos, Susie comienza a creer que ella tiene el talento necesario para convertirse en una estrella internacional del pop. La mujer le dice a Susie que ella tiene muchos clientes futuros listos para conocerla, siempre que ella le pague mil dólares.

videos.title: Kimi mala
videos.overview: En la clase de Ciencias, mientras construyen baterías de toronjas, el "chico malo" de la escuela, Z, hace explotar las suyas causando que los pedazos se atasquen en la nariz de Carlitos. Cuando Carlitos tiene que ir con la enfermera, el maestro, el Sr. Beaker, empareja a Kimi con Z para el experimento.

videos.title: Magnates adolescentes
videos.overview: Para ganar dinero para comprar entradas para el concierto de los Sulky Boys, la banda vende productos basados en las ideas de Dil. Al principio, Dil inventa cintu-acuarios (un cinturón con un pez en su interior), pero esta idea es pronto robada por Angélica, quien también está tratando de ganar dinero para la mercancía de los Sulky Boys y esto pasa de moda porque el Subdirector Pangborn tiene.

videos.title: La verdad y sus consecuencias
videos.overview: Tommy se emociona cuando se entera de un inminente concurso de cine que va a ser juzgado por su director favorito, Martin Costomiris.

videos.title: Carlitos se enamora
videos.overview: Carlitos está enamorado de Nicole Boscerelli, pero él tiene miedo de hablar con ella porque ella no sabe que él existe. Desesperado, él le pide ayuda a Kimi para cambiar su imagen para hacer que Nicole se fije en él. Ella acepta con la condición de que Carlitos la cubra en su turno en el Java Lava para poder ir a un concierto con Lil.

videos.title: El ladrón
videos.overview: Hay un ladrón que ha estado robando cosas de los jardines, así que Betty DeVille monta una guardia del vecindario para atrapar al ladrón.

videos.title: Aventuras en el río
videos.overview: Betty y Chas llevan a Tommy, Carlitos y Phil a hacer canotaje. Se descubre que Tommy no es el héroe totalmente valiente que todos piensan, ya que él le tiene miedo al agua, pero enfrenta su miedo cuando salva a Phil de ahogarse.

videos.title: Hermano, ¿Puedes compartir tiempo conmigo?
videos.overview: Tommy gana el Premio Nacional de la Silla del Pequeño Director por su cortometraje, Almuerzo Caleidoscopio. Sin embargo, Dil se entristece por el éxito de Tommy ya que siente que él y Tommy están separándose y Tommy se olvidará de él cuando se vuelva famoso.

videos.title: Los viejos y los inquietos
videos.overview: El abuelo Lou acompaña a Tommy y su clase a un viaje de campo al Museo del Cuerpo Humano. Tommy se avergüenza, ya que el abuelo Lou es muy lento y ahora está mucho más viejo que lo que solía ser, por lo que no pueden hacer todo lo que se puede hacer en el museo y él sigue contándole viejas historias, las que nadie encuentra interesantes.

videos.title: Las fallas de Cupido
videos.overview: Hay un baile de San Valentín. Dil se hace amigo con el nuevo chico, Lil’ Q, quien es un experto en patear pelotas, pero su pelotita resulta ser una flecha de cupido.

videos.title: El engaño
videos.overview: Los chicos le hacen una broma a Dil para que piense que los extraterrestres lo han contactado y le están hablando a través de Tommy. Angélica planea ser emparejada con Sean en el Baile de Primavera de la escuela.

videos.title: Carrera equívoca
videos.overview: Tommy y la banda tomaron una prueba de aptitud para obtener una pista de lo que quieren ser cuando crezcan.

videos.title: Con Calma es mejor
videos.overview: Una chica mayor, Francine, humilla públicamente a Tommy, y él no sabe por qué. Mientras tanto, Angélica trata de aumentar la popularidad de su sitio web con vergonzosas y humillantes fotos de la gente.

videos.title: Memorias de una Finster
videos.overview: Al asignarse un proyecto de un árbol genealógico, Carlitos y Kimi se emocionan de que solo tienen una pieza de tarea entre ellos ya que son hermanos.

videos.title: Todo por una nariz
videos.overview: Angélica ha sido invitada a una de las fiestas de Savannah, y deb encontrar un vestido que no haya usado antes.

videos.title: El campamento del terror
videos.overview: El Campamento Everwood parece ser la oportunidad de que la película de terror de Tommy agarre vuelo, especialmente cuando descubren la maldición del Campamento Everwood.

videos.title: La atareada Susie
videos.overview:
Susie es obligada a escoger entre cantar en el programa de talentos en TV, y liderar su equipo de lenguajes en el concurso de lenguajes, lo que se da el mismo día..

Mientras, Lil hace que Phil se haga pasar por ella para decirle a un chico nerd, Geoffrey, que a ella no le gusta él.

videos.title: El cumpleaños de Angélica
videos.overview: La chica más bonita y popular de la escuela, Savannah, a quien Angélica de verdad admira, decide dar su fiesta el mismo día que Angélica da la suya. Tommy y Phil, asombrados de que alguien de verdad pudiera ser malo con Angélica, usan la obsesión de Savannah con Senor Jumping Bean para arruinar su plan.

videos.title: Salvando a Cynthia
videos.overview: Angélica redecora su habitación. Su madre, Charlotte, accidentalmente malinterpretó a su hija cuando dijo que podía donar "Todos los juguetes". Ahora que Angélica se dio cuuenta de que extraña a Cynthia, ella sale a su encuentro. Sin embargo, llegan a una tienda cuyo dueño es muy exigente.

videos.title: La pareja de Ciencias
videos.overview: La escuela de Tommy tiene una feria de ciencias y Tommy tiene una idea de crear una máquina que pueda emparejar los calcetines por color para que nunca termines usando calcetines raros. Luego de pedirle a su padre, Stu, un pequeño consejo, Stu presta más ayuda de lo que su hijo le pidió y se toma el experimento.

videos.title: ¿Exizzyste o no exizzyste?
videos.overview: Carlitos se postula para Inspector de Seguridad Escolar. Dil tiene un amigo extraterrestre imaginario llamado Izzy.

videos.title: El Finster que se robó la Navidad
videos.overview: Mientras las fiestas se aproximan, Carlitos está temiendo otra Navidad fácil de olvidar. Para poder avivar las cosas, accidentalmente rob un gran árbol (para reemplazar el lamentable que su padre escogió). Cuando descubre que toda la comunidad está en busca del ladrón, él formula un plan para remediar la situación.

videos.title: Proyecto Carlitos
videos.overview: Angélica intenta ayudar a que Carlitos se vuelva más popular para un proyecto escolar, pero se vuelve en su contra cuando él toma su consejo y se vuelve más popular que ella.

videos.title: Miedo de caer
videos.overview: En un viaje a un centro turístico en una montaña, Tommy desarrolla su primer enamoramiento con una chica llamada Olivia, otra invitada en la cabaña. Carlitos se vuelve un tercero en discordia, y se siente alienado cuando Tommy prefiere pasar tiempo con Olivia a ayudarlo a superar su miedo a las alturas.

videos.title: La suerte del ciego
videos.overview: Susie tiene la oportunidad de cantar en el increíble parque temático, “Montaña Remojo”. Los chicos están encantados de ir, no tanto por el espectáculo, sino porque podrán ir a la atracción más grande de todas, “El Cañón del Látigo”.

videos.title: Ya-yo-vio
videos.overview: Toda la escuela está obsesionada con el juego de cartas de rol “Ya-yo-vio”, excepto Carlitos. Cuando, finalmente, Carlitos comienza a jugar, no puede parar, y hasta es contratado por Angélica para hacer sus tareas a cambio de más tarjetas.

videos.title: Curse of Reptar
videos.overview: After Stu sells an invention, he tells the kids that he's splurging on a built-in swimming pool. While digging up the yard, the construction crew unearths the Rats' old mechanical Reptar toy. The kids fondly remember it, but decide to throw it away, until, during an electrical storm, they become convinced that they've angered Reptar. They ultimately decide to rescue the toy, and realize that, although they're growing up, they can't forget their past.

videos.title: It's Karma, Dude!
videos.overview: When theres a talent show on and they've got places for singing, Angelica signs up, but Tommy tells Angelica to let Susie know. When Angelica calls, its on the answering machine, but it breaks. Angelica then pretends she's reminding her in front of Tommy, which when Susie comes back to school, eventually believes in Angelica. Meanwhile, Chuckie, Lil and Phil help Ms O'Keats with her part of the talent show, even though its a bit lame and they have to wear weird costumes and do other weird movements. Dil lets them know about Karma and tells them about that afternoon (Phil, Lil and Chuckie pulled a prank in assembly) and if they do something bad, something bad will happen to them, as in them being humiliated in front of the whole school. The next morning, Angelica's face breaks out with zits and comes to Dil's advice. Dil tells her to do good deeds but it just gets worse. At the show, Angelica admits to Susie she knew the answering machine was broken and swaps places with Susie. When Chu

videos.title: The Big Score
videos.overview: It's soccer season and as per usual, Phil has soccer-on-the-brain. But when Lil casually joins the team, she surprises everyone, including herself, by instantly becoming a super star. At first Phil is excited about having another soccer-head in the family, but when Lil outshines him, he starts to resent her. When Lil finally realizes how upset Phil is, she has to decide whether to walk away from something she loves or continue to play and risk pushing away her only brother.

videos.title: Rats Race
videos.overview: Tommy and the gang decide to put together a boxcar to compete in the upcoming derby. Can they make it to the finals, or will Angelica spoil their plans by entering her own car in the race?

videos.title: Wouldn't It Be Nice?
videos.overview: Susie thinks that Angelica doesn't think much about the future. While Angelica worries about getting a navel piercing, Susie tries to get a scholarship to a good college. So when a school field trip accidentally leaves the two girls stranded in the big city, who will end up having the smarts to get them back safely?

videos.title: Dude, Where's My Horse?
videos.overview: As babies the Rugrats used to dream about being cowboys, and as tweens they finally get to make those dreams come true! When the gang is invited to spend a week at a dude ranch, will Tommy and his city slicker pals adapt to the ways of the old west?

videos.title: R.V. Having Fun Yet?
videos.overview: When Susie gets chosen to sing at a big parade in New York City, the tweenage Rugrats hit the road with their moms on a cross country trip! Will Betty's clunky old motor home be able to make it to NYC and see all the stops along the way (like the world's biggest ball of yarn)? Will Tommy and his pals go crazy from lack of video games and TV? Will Chuckie finally get kissed?

videos.title: Rachel, Rachel
videos.overview: Tommy attends a Hebrew school to prepare for his bar mitzvah. While there, he meets Rachel, and falls deeply in love with her. After a while he lies and says that his father, Stu is a rabbi but at the Hebrew School Picnic Rachel finds out and they find out they are both working on the same house.

videos.title: Separate But Equal
videos.overview: As Phil and Lil's birthday nears, the twins realize that they are more different from each other than they think. Phil is getting to like girls, and Lil is wearing a pink training bra. After a shocking incident, they decide to have separate parties for the boys and the girls as they try to out-prank each other.

videos.title: Ladies' Man
videos.overview: Susie trains Harold to help him get a date with Angelica. He soon becomes the most wanted boy in school.

videos.title: Lost at Sea
videos.overview: Angelica falls for Darryl, but she gets too nervous to talk to him whenever he is around. Her mom loses her CEO job and decides to become a full-time mom. Then, they get stranded together on a sail boat on the same day as Darryl's rock concert.

videos.title: O Bro, Where Art Thou?
videos.overview: Tommy is getting annoyed by Dil's eccentric behavior, and he wants some space from his little brother. When the gang visits the Cirque Extravaganza Day Camp, Dil meets a whole group of kids who are just as eccentric as heÿis who invite him to join their troupe permanently. Will he choose his new circus friends over Tommy?

videos.title: Rat Traps
videos.overview: When the gang sneaks into a PG-13 movie at the mall, Angelica catches them, and she has excellent blackmail fodder. The mall then closes with them locked inside with two robbers. Chuckie imitates the main character of the movie they just saw and saves the day.

videos.title: In the Family's Way
videos.overview: Phil falls for the captain of the school soccer team. Meanwhile, Vice-Principal Pangborn asks Dil, Tommy, and Chuckie to hang around with his nephew, who turns out to be irritating and annoying.

videos.title: A DeVille House Divided
videos.overview: Phil has a crush on Lil's best friend and soccer teammate Wally they start hanging out more often, making Lil feel out of the loop. So Lil develops a plan to pull them apart. Phil and Wally's relationship fell apart when Lil told Wally that he does not like her. When Phil finds out that Lil lied to Wally, he becomes upset at his sister.

videos.title: Susie Goes Bad Lite
videos.overview: Tired of being considered a "goody goody" by the popular kids, Susie tries desperately to prove that she can be a bad girl.

videos.title: Trading Places
videos.overview: When Chuckie discovers that Kimi is upset, he comes to the conclusion that she hates how her room looks. The gang decides to help him redesign it for her while Angelica keeps Kimi busy. Dil tries giving advice, but they choose to ignore him. It is later discovered that she is homesick for Japan and her biological father. Chas and Kira have a big surprise for Kimi.

videos.title: TP+KF
videos.overview: While the gang try on their Halloween costumes in the Finster's garage, they find TP+KF carved on the wall. Chuckie believes that Tommy has a crush on Kimi. The argument between Tommy and Chuckie escalates to where their friendship falls apart. So the rest of the gang tries to bring the two back together, but backfires. The two eventually make up when Chuckie saves Tommy from the middle school goons who were chasing him.

videos.title: Super Hero Worship
videos.overview: When a comic book starring Chuckie's favorite superhero Armadillo Dave gets cancelled, he becomes too depressed to help Tommy with his science fair project. Tommy has to buy a rat for his project, but the last rat available is a mean one. It scares everybody. Kimi made Tommy a simple one lane track for his rat, much to his disappointment as he feels he would get a failing grade for it, but needs Chuckie so he can get a good grade on it since Chuckie has done it before. The gang tries to find Chuckie a new hero to worship.

videos.title: What's Love Got To Do With It?
videos.overview: Angelica's teacher is having a baby so she brings in a hot handsome substitute teacher that Angelica falls in love with. She tries to date him by failing her assignments. Meanwhile, Tommy, Phil, and Chuckie are part of the tennis club run by Pangborn. Chuckie is trying to avoid showering at the boys' locker room, but when he takes the chance, he realizes he has nothing to worry about.

videos.title: All Broke Up
videos.overview: Tommy's girlfriend, Rachel is moving away, and he's cool with it, but is not sure why. However, his friends think otherwise, believing him to be in denial. Tommy tries going about his life as normal, but everyone keeps trying to show him compassion, annoying him greatly. Tommy is advised by Dil to go along with the plan so his friends will leave him alone. However, when Tommy hooks up with another girl, the gang unexpectedly have Rachel show up to surprise Tommy. Seeing him with another girl so soon is too much for her to bear, so she walks away again, leaving Tommy to cry for real this time. Chuckie then shows up at Tommy's house to comfort him.

videos.title: Petition This!
videos.overview: Kimi leads a petition drive to ban cell phones in school. To prevent her from having the cell phones banned, Angelica hoodwinks Chuckie into helping her keep cell phones in school in her petition drive, while Susie helps Kimi counteract. Things get worse when during the debate at a school assembly, Chuckie reveals to the audience that Kimi wants a cell phone for Christmas, and they end up not speaking to each other and threatening not to attend their parents' (Kira and Chas) 10 year wedding anniversary. However, Angelica, Susie, and Tommy force them to attend to attend. At the Java Lava, Chuckie and Kimi argue with each other about cell phones until they make up after Tommy shows a video of their parents' wedding when they were babies.

videos.title: Bad Blood
videos.overview: With Stu and Didi away at an Invention Convention, Dil wants to host a viewing party for a "real" alien autopsy video with Tommy. But when both Grandpa Lou and Grandpa Boris show up to babysit the kids, they all start to have a feud. This gets even more difficult when Phil, Lil, and Chuckie show up and Dil invites 10 other kids to come see it, much to Tommy's frustration.

videos.title: Brothers Grimm
videos.overview: When Tommy's gang's parents feel that they are spending too much time watching TV, they ban it from the house. So in order to get their televisions back, they do something dare-devilish. They make a tree house with a zip-line in the backyard to scare and anger their parents into giving them their TV back.

videos.title: Golden Boy
videos.overview: In the series finale, When Tommy forgoes going to the traditional opening day ball game outing with his Grandpa in order to patch things up with his former girlfriend Rachel, Lou takes Dil instead. This makes Tommy jealous as he and Dil compete to be Lou's favorite grandson during a fishing trip.

videos.title: All Growed Up!
videos.overview: All Growed Up is a horror episode of Rugrats that aired on July 21, 2001 during the show's 8th season to celebrate the series' 10th anniversary, and acts as the pilot episode of All Grown Up! Its premise was to focus on what the babies' lives would be like if they were 10 years older. It proved to be popular enough for a spinoff based on it to be made.
